name: The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity
detailed_description:
The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© is a survival horror action-adventure open-world RPG game built in RPG Maker MZ and is a prequel to The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows© (Will contain spoilers for The Clown's Forest, This game is best played after beating the first game)

STORY

Blitzo lost control while hunting down Michael. Jonathan had slipped back into control momentarily. Blitzo taunts Jonathan, vowing to destroy him once and for all. Jonathan, stuck in Blitzo's hivemind, a version of Hartown twisted and mutated to fit Blitzo's twisted nature.

An ally immediately helps Jonathan escape his prison, and then, they start working together to try and bring down Blitzo from the inside, to allow Jonathan to return back to his body to protect Michael. 

GAMEPLAY

The Clown's Forest: Whispers of Insanity© Is a top-down Survival Horror game set between the events of The Clown's Forest© and The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows©, Jonathan has to survive nightmares of Blitzo's doing. Find or buy weapons and protective gear to protect yourself from the nightmares that roam Hartown and Hartown Park in a Semi-Open World Horror RPG.

Fight Zombie-like creatures with turn-based combat. Work with allies and level up your characters to try and save the hivemind and to bring Jonathan back to the real world.
